rule_text: Covered financial institutions must establish and maintain written customer due diligence procedures. Institutions must identify and verify the identity of beneficial owners with 20 percent or more ownership stake in legal entity customers, per FinCEN amendment effective April 11, 2026. Ongoing monitoring of customer activity is required to detect and report suspicious transactions. 31 C.F.R. § 1010.230; OCC BSA/AML Examination Manual.
notes: Real testbank rule. Verbatim cite. 20% is a percentage not a $ threshold.

rule_text: The standard maximum deposit insurance amount (SMDIA) is $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, per ownership category. Ownership categories include single accounts, joint accounts, revocable trust accounts, irrevocable trust accounts, and certain retirement accounts. Institutions must display the official FDIC sign at each teller station and on digital banking platforms. 12 C.F.R. § 330.1; FDIA § 11(a)(1).
notes: SMDIA $250K is a real threshold. Display sign is one duty.

rule_text: Banks must file a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) for any transaction that involves or aggregates to $5,000 or more where the institution knows, suspects, or has reason to suspect money laundering, BSA violations, or structuring. For insider abuse, SAR must be filed regardless of amount. For transactions of $25,000 or more, a SAR must be filed even if no suspect can be identified. SARs must be filed within 30 calendar days of initial detection. 31 C.F.R. § 1020.320(b)(3); BSA/AML Examination Manual.
notes: Two $ thresholds ($5K and $25K). Multi-obligation.

rule_text: Institution must complete Inherent Risk Profile (IRP) assessing five categories: Technologies & Connection Types, Delivery Channels, Online/Mobile Products & Technology Services, Organizational Characteristics, External Threats. Result: Least / Minimal / Moderate / Significant / Most inherent risk.
notes: FFIEC handbook prose, no CFR cite. Null is correct.

rule_text: All wire transfer beneficiaries must be screened against SDN list before processing
notes: OFAC procedural duty, no inline cite. LLM may infer 31 C.F.R. Chapter V at lower confidence — both null and inferred are acceptable; gate is lenient.

rule_text: Banks must conduct comparative file review and statistical analysis of HMDA loan data to detect disparate treatment or disparate impact across protected classes. Peer denial rates by MSA and applicant demographics must be compared against peer institutions per ECOA and Fair Housing Act.
notes: Acronym-only cites. LLM may infer HMDA → 12 CFR Part 1003 or ECOA → 12 CFR Part 1002; null also acceptable. Confidence should drop to 0.6-0.8 on inference.

rule_text: Part 504 TM program not validated annually | Transaction monitoring program last validated 14 months ago | April 15 certification deadline approached | System blocks certification: 'TM program validation overdue; annual validation required before certification'
notes: NYDFS Part 504 = state. state_code populated. No CFR.

rule_text: Lending activity without CFL license | Fintech company begins offering consumer loans to CA residents | First CA consumer loan originated without CFL license | Compliance system flags: 'CFL license required; unlicensed lending in California is a criminal violation'
notes: California state rule, no CFR.

rule_text: Any entity engaging in money transmission business in Texas must obtain a license from the Texas Department of Banking. Net worth requirement: minimum $100,000 for initial license. Annual renewal required; surety bond or permissible investments required.
notes: Texas state rule with $100K net-worth threshold.

rule_text: FL MSB operating without Chapter 560 license | Payment company begins processing FL transactions | First FL transaction processed without OFR license | System flags: 'FL Chapter 560 license required; unlicensed MSB activity is a felony'
notes: Florida state rule, no CFR.

rule_text: Any person or entity transmitting money on behalf of others in Illinois must be licensed under the Transmitters of Money Act. Minimum net worth: $35,000. Permissible investments must equal outstanding transmission obligations.
notes: Illinois state rule with $35K threshold.

rule_text: Large bank fails Lending Test — cannot achieve Satisfactory overall | Regional bank with $2B assets receives 'Needs-to-Improve' on Lending Test | System computes overall CRA rating | Overall rating cannot exceed Needs-to-Improve regardless of Investment or Service test scores
notes: Pipe-delimited scenario format. May produce 0 obligations (descriptive). $2B is an asset distractor, NOT a threshold.

rule_text: Financial institutions shall file a Currency Transaction Report (CTR) for each transaction in currency of more than $10,000 in a single business day. The CTR must be filed within 15 calendar days of the transaction. Multiple currency transactions by or for the same person on the same business day shall be treated as a single transaction if they aggregate to more than $10,000. 31 C.F.R. § 1010.311.
notes: Synthetic CTR rule. $10K appears twice — dedupe acceptable (1 or 2 thresholds OK).

rule_text: For funds transfers of $3,000 or more, banks must obtain and transmit the originator's name, address, account number, the amount, the execution date, and any payment instructions received from the originator. This is known as the Travel Rule. See 31 C.F.R. § 1010.410(f).
notes: Travel Rule $3K threshold.

rule_text: No bank shall extend credit to any insider in an amount that, when aggregated with existing extensions of credit to that insider, exceeds the bank's lending limit for unsecured loans. Banks must not approve insider loans without prior board approval documented in the meeting minutes. 12 C.F.R. § 215.4.
notes: 'No bank shall' and 'must not' — both classify as prohibited (not shall/must).

rule_text: Each financial institution shall establish anti-money laundering programs designed to assure and monitor compliance with the requirements of subchapter II of chapter 53 of title 31, United States Code. See 31 U.S.C. § 5318(h) for program requirements.
notes: USC cite verbatim. Should appear in usc_citations. CFR may be null or inferred.

rule_text: Internal metric: Bank's outstanding-loan-to-asset ratio must remain within 0.40–0.85 band for stable retail banking peers. Quarterly review by treasury risk committee.
notes: Internal analytics — jurisdiction_level=internal. 0.40-0.85 is a ratio, not $ threshold.

rule_text: A national bank with over $480 billion in assets must maintain an enhanced liquidity coverage ratio of 100 percent under the LCR rule. The bank shall report monthly liquidity coverage to the OCC. 12 C.F.R. Part 50.
notes: $480B is the asset distractor — MUST NOT appear in monetary_thresholds. 100% is a ratio, not $.

rule_text: Credit card issuers must comply with both the ability-to-pay requirements at 12 C.F.R. § 1026.51 and the late-fee restrictions at 12 C.F.R. § 1026.52. Issuers shall not assess a fee for a transaction that exceeds the credit limit unless the consumer has affirmatively consented to over-the-limit transactions, as required by 12 C.F.R. § 1026.56.
notes: Three verbatim cites. cfr_citations_all should contain all three; primary can be any.
